goalSummary: Injected insights appear cut off mid-sentence in the agent's context, showing only a fraction of the original content even when budget headroom seems available.

facts.why: Runbook must reference the exact file implementing the per-insight character cap
The specific character caps for injection (1,200) and backfill (2,000) passes must be documented
The specific relevance threshold value used to drop insights before budget assembly must be stated
